paite: Hiai thilte nungin van akipan angel dang, thuneihna liantak nei, hongpai khe suk tuh ka muta a; a thupinain leitung tuh a vaksak ta a.
english: After these things, I saw another angel coming down out of the sky, having great authority. The earth was illuminated with his glory.

paite: Huan aw ngaihtak in a kikouta a, Chimta, chimta Babulon kho thupi, dawite omna leh, kha nin tengteng kulh leh vasa nin leh huathuai teng kulh a honghita hi.
english: He cried with a mighty voice, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, and she has become a habitation of demons, a prison of every unclean spirit, and a prison of every unclean and hateful bird!

paite: Amingaihna uain-a nam tengteng hihpuka a om ua, leitung kumpipaten amah a kingaihpih ua, leitung sumsinte a nuamtat luatnaa a hong hautak jiakun, a chi hi.
english: For all the nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality, the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth grew rich from the abundance of her luxury.”

paite: Huan van akipanin aw dangin, hichi banga a gen ka ja a, Ka mite, a khelhnaa na pankhak louhna ding un leh ahi na kai louhna dingun, amah akipanin hongpai khia un:
english: I heard another voice from heaven, saying, “Come out of her, my people, that you have no participation in her sins, and that you don’t receive of her plagues,

paite: A khelhna tuh van a tung hialta ngala, huan Pathinin a khelhnate a theigige hi.
english: for her sins have reached to the sky, and God has remembered her iniquities.

paite: Aman a piak bang lellelin, a kiangah pia unla, amah gamtatna azah nihin thuk kik un: a helna nou ah, amah adingin a zah nihin hel sak unla.
english: Return to her just as she returned, and repay her double as she did, and according to her works. In the cup which she mixed, mix to her double.

paite: A kithupi sakna zahzah leh a noptatna zahzahin, amah bawlgim unla, hihlungkham un: aman tuh a lungsimin, Kumpinuin ka tu a, meithai ka hi kei, bangchi mahin ka lungkham ngei kei ding, a chih jiakin.
english: However much she glorified herself, and grew wanton, so much give her of torment and mourning. For she says in her heart, ‘I sit a queen, and am no widow, and will in no way see mourning.’

paite: Huaijiakin ni khat sungin a gatna: sihna leh lungkhamna leh kialna a hongtung ding hi; huan amah tuh meiin haltum vekin om in teh; amah tunga vaihawm Toupa Pathian tuh a hat jiakin.
english: Therefore in one day her plagues will come: death, mourning, and famine; and she will be utterly burned with fire; for the Lord God who has judged her is strong.

paite: Huan leitunga kumpipate, amah kingaihpiha, amah toh nuamtat a omten, amah halna meikhu a muh chiang un, amah tuh kahin mau un chin.
english: The kings of the earth, who committed sexual immorality and lived wantonly with her, will weep and wail over her, when they look at the smoke of her burning,

paite: Hihnata a omna tuh kihtaa gamla pai dingin, Tunggik, tunggik, kho thupi Babulon kho hat! Dak kal khat sunga na tunga vaihawmna a hongtuntak jiakin chi unteh.
english: standing far away for the fear of her torment, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, Babylon, the strong city! For your judgment has come in one hour.’

paite: Huan leitunga sumsinten, sumsinna van uh kuamahin a lei louh jiak un, amah tuh kahin sun un chin.
english: The merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, for no one buys their merchandise any more;

paite: Dangkaeng leh dangkaa sumsinna vante bang, suang mantamte bang, tuikep suang bang, puan malngat hoih bang, puan san bang, maimompuan bang, puan eng bang, sing namtui teng bang, saihaa bawlvan teng bang, sing mantampen chia van bawlteng bang, sumsan leh sik leh marbul sunga belsuan bawlteng bang:
english: merchandise of gold, silver, precious stones, pearls, fine linen, purple, silk, scarlet, all expensive wood, every vessel of ivory, every vessel made of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble;

paite: leh singgui thak bang, namtui bang, namtuihalchi bang, thau namtui bang, chim bang, uain bang, thau bang, buhnel bang, buh bang, belam bang huan sakol leh kangtalai leh sal bang, mite hinnate te bang.
english: and cinnamon, incense, perfume, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, sheep, horses, chariots, and people’s bodies and souls.

paite: Huan na lungsima na deih, gahten nang hontai mangsan ua, huan thil limchileh hoih tengin nang a honmanthat san ua, muh nawn ahi ngei kei ding uhi.
english: The fruits which your soul lusted after have been lost to you, and all things that were dainty and sumptuous have perished from you, and you will find them no more at all.

paite: Hiai thiltea sumsinte, amah jiaka haua bawlten, amah hihnata a omna lauin gamla pai dingin, kapin a sun ding uh.
english: The merchants of these things, who were made rich by her, will stand far away for the fear of her torment, weeping and mourning;

paite: Tunggik, tunggik, kho thupi, puan malngat hoih leh a san leh a enga kijema, dangkaeng leh suangmantam leh tuikepsuanga kivannu hi!
english: saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, she who was dressed in fine linen, purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls!

paite: Dak kal khatin hichi tela hauhna thupi tuh bangmah loua bawl a om jiakin, chiin. Huan longpute leh koilam koilama longa tungte leh longmite leh tuipia nek zong tengteng tuh gamla pi ah a ding ua.
english: For in an hour such great riches are made desolate.’ Every shipmaster, and everyone who sails anywhere, and mariners, and as many as gain their living by sea, stood far away,

paite: Amah halna meikhu a et un, a kikou ua, Huan kho thupi bangkoi a om a? chiin.
english: and cried out as they looked at the smoke of her burning, saying, ‘What is like the great city?’

paite: Huan, amau a lu tunguah leivui a kibuak ua a kikou ua, kap leh sunin, Tunggik, tunggik, kho thupi huaia tuipia mi long nei tengteng amah manphat jiaka hauhsakin a om ua! dakkal khat sungin amah tuh bangmalou a hita.
english: They cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and mourning, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, in which all who had their ships in the sea were made rich by reason of her great wealth!’ For in one hour is she made desolate.

paite: Aw nang van, leh Aw nou misiangthoute, leh nou sawltakte leh nou jawlneite, amah tungah kipahkhum un; na tung ua a vaihawmna tuh Pathianin amah tungah vai a hawmtak jiakin. a chi uhi.
english: “Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets; for God has judged your judgment on her.”

paite: Huan angel hat khatin buh gawina suang lian pi hileh kilawm suang khat a domta a, huan tupi ah a pai luta, Hichi bangin kho thupi, Babulon tuh nakpia hihchipin om inchin, huan muhkhiak nawn louh hialin om in teh.
english: A mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying, “Thus with violence will Babylon, the great city, be thrown down, and will be found no more at all.

paite: Huan gosem tumte leh la siamte leh tamngai tumte leh pengkul tumte, na sungah kiza nawnkei hial unteh; huan khutsiam kuamah siamna nei himhim, na sungah muh khiakin om nawn kei hial un chin; huan khawl ging himhim na sung ah kiza nawn kei hial in teh.
english: The voice of harpists, minstrels, flute players, and trumpeters will be heard no more at all in you. No craftsman, of whatever craft, will be found any more at all in you. The sound of a mill will be heard no more at all in you.

paite: Huan meivak vakna, na sungahvak nawn kei hial inchin; huan mouneipa aw leh mou aw, na sung ah kiza nawn kei hial inchin: na sumsinte leitung kumpipate ahi ngal ua; na bumsiamnain nam tengteng tuh khemin a omta ngal ua.Huan amah sungah jawlneite sisan, leh misiangthoute sisan leh leitunga thaha omte tengteng sisan a kimu khia hi, a chi a.
english: The light of a lamp will shine no more at all in you. The voice of the bridegroom and of the bride will be heard no more at all in you; for your merchants were the princes of the earth; for with your sorcery all the nations were deceived.

paite: Huan amah sungah jawlneite sisan, leh misiangthoute sisan leh leitunga thaha omte tengteng sisan a kimu khia hi, a chi a.
english: In her was found the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all who have been slain on the earth.”
